independence_tier: external clinical cohort — different country / lab / AST method than the decoder's US-NCBI-PD tuning provenance; clonality/lineage disclosed in the roll-up. NOT the same as methodology-independent: comparability rests on the same AMRFinder -O + DRUG_RULE.

strict_disjoint_floor.note: biosamples absent from every prior selected*.tsv. The other 134 appear in SIBLING AR Bank cohorts (ceftriaxone/cipro/gentamicin) -- same isolates, DIFFERENT drugs; the meropenem label was never used and the frozen meropenem rule was never fit on them.

buckets.overlap_disclosure: cohort_manifest is accession-based and DRUG-BLIND, so a strict application cuts this cohort to the floor above. Primary = full set with overlap disclosed.

species_restriction.why: the FROZEN Klebsiella meropenem cell used amrfinder_organism=Klebsiella_pneumoniae. AMRFinder's -O drives species-specific point-mutation screening and curation, so scoring oxytoca/aerogenes/variicola under a pneumoniae organism flag would be a silent methodological error. ozaenae (n=2) is arguably K. pneumoniae subsp. ozaenae and is a JUDGEMENT CALL -- excluded here for an exact-species match, and named so it can be reversed deliberately.
